requirementsVi: Nhận lời rõ ràng, không chỉ cảm ơn lời mời.

Nêu sự quan tâm và hỏi chuẩn bị bằng câu gián tiếp.
samples.summaryVi: Lớp công nghệ cho người lớn tuổi cần chậm, nhóm nhỏ và cho lặp lại thao tác.

paragraphs.label: Mở thư và nhận lời
paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

Thank you for your invitation to a beginner computer class. I am pleased to accept and would welcome the opportunity to take part. I appreciate the time you have spent making the arrangements.

paragraphs.template:
Dear [danh xưng và họ người nhận],

Thank you for your invitation to [sự kiện / hoạt động]. I am pleased to accept and would welcome the opportunity to take part. I appreciate the time you have spent making the arrangements.

paragraphs.label: Xác nhận sắp xếp
paragraphs.text: I understand that the event will take place at the local library on Saturday at two in the afternoon. I will plan my journey accordingly. Please let me know if there are any changes to the time or location.
paragraphs.noteVi: Xác nhận thông tin người mời đã đưa.

the local library
on
Saturday at two in the afternoon
. I will plan my journey accordingly. Please let me know if there are any changes to the time or location.

paragraphs.template: I understand that the event will take place at [địa điểm] on [ngày và giờ]. I will plan my journey accordingly. Please let me know if there are any changes to the time or location.

paragraphs.label: Chuẩn bị và hỗ trợ
paragraphs.text: I am particularly interested in the opportunity to practise sending messages and joining a video call. One reason is that older people can use useful online services more independently. I can bring a phone or tablet, but I would be grateful if you could confirm whether anything else is required. I would also be happy to assist with the preparations if needed.

Yours sincerely,
